stem: Which quotation from the excerpt from “The Leper’s Squint” best supports the idea that Desmond’s wife is more easygoing than he is?
instruction: Use “The Leper’s Squint” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: "Maybe she’s making notes on us. Maybe she’s writing a book. . . ." (paragraph 2)

options.label: G
options.text: "I can’t live with someone listening to me breathe," Desmond said. (paragraph 3)

options.label: H
options.text: She who could adjust to anything, or absorb it. (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: she may even believe that he is glad to be rid of her for the day, after all those weeks of unavoidable closeness. (paragraph 5)
